tools.name: run_sql
tools.description: Execute a read-only PerfettoSQL query against the active TraceProcessor engine (live stream, captured snapshot, or loaded trace) when the structured tools do not answer a specific follow-up question.

sql.description: PerfettoSQL query to run. Keep results bounded with LIMIT.

tools.name: note
tools.description: Record a verified finding in the investigation log. Must cite one or more evidence_ids returned by earlier tool calls in this session.

evidence_ids.description: List of evidence IDs (e.g. ['E1', 'E2']) backing this finding.

tools.name: device_status
tools.description: Return connected device status, active live streaming telemetry, and list of captured snapshots available in this session.

tools.name: take_snapshot
tools.description: Capture an instant 60-second snapshot of the connected device (cloning the full-detail ring buffer including scheduling, binder, and block I/O) and switch focus to the new snapshot.

label.description: Optional short label for this snapshot (e.g. 'baseline' or 'under-load').

tools.name: run_workload
tools.description: Run a curated reproducible system-wide workload on the connected device (or a custom shell command with user approval). Useful for reproducing memory pressure, storage contention, or CPU/thermal load before taking a snapshot.

command.description: Shell command when workload='custom'. Requires explicit user approval before running.

snapshot_after.description: If true, automatically capture an instant snapshot when the workload finishes.
